purpose: Pre-write binding for the permanent platform workspace account and invitation-centre closure. It admits no final business, cleanup, L2 or UAT claim.

consumerBindings.businessTask: Within a selected group workspace, independently search accounts or govern invitations; enter details before account actions.

controlFacts.business-task: Permanent account and invitation tabs are distinct platform governance tasks.
controlFacts.entry-interaction-form: ProTable account search, name to detail drawer, invitation panel in a sibling tab.
controlFacts.data-cascade: Account type/ref candidates and invitation type/ref/role candidates are owner-backed and tab-local.
controlFacts.permission-state: Platform session and enabled workspace only; no workspace capability.
controlFacts.refresh-navigation: Latest detail owns account mutation follow-up; invitation command readback refreshes invitation state.
controlFacts.test-id-accessibility: Existing account and invitation controls remain independently addressable.

consumerBindings.businessTask: Show account facts, assignments and bounded successful authentication history before opening account action confirmation.

controlFacts.entry-interaction-form: Name opens loading drawer immediately before detail read.
controlFacts.data-provenance: Plain mobile and login history are explicit authenticated platform owner facts; audit and invitation data are excluded.
controlFacts.permission-state: Actions use latest detail CAS/idempotency values.
controlFacts.refresh-navigation: Action completion returns to owner detail readback.

consumerBindings.businessTask: Permanently list, select candidates for, create, cancel and reissue cross-node invitations.

controlFacts.entry-interaction-form: The sibling invitation tab uses the administrator-list Card header for task explanation and 发出邀请, then its independent ProTable list, details and commands; a labelled link opens the existing public invitation page without exposing its token.
controlFacts.data-cascade: Type to opaque organization ref to role; upstream changes clear downstream values.
controlFacts.permission-state: Platform session without workspace capability; owner rechecks commands.
controlFacts.refresh-navigation: Owner command readback refreshes invitation view without entering public acceptance.

consumerBindings.businessTask: Retain the explicitly selected group workspace while navigating into the permanent account and invitation centre.

controlFacts.entry-interaction-form: The shell selector is the only workspace selection source.
controlFacts.refresh-navigation: Passive page navigation never clears selection; only an owner-changing refresh rechecks it against the complete enabled list.
controlFacts.permission-state: Selection is display context, not authorization.
